title: What do these six subtractions give with tokens?
description: Six subtractions are done with tokens. Three have enough tokens to lift off, and three need zero pairs put out first. The tokens that stay give each answer and its sign.
teaching_notes: One idea: take the tokens away, and if there are too few, put out zero pairs first. Watch for students who forget the sign of the tokens that stay.

video_script.why: The child evaluates six subtractions with tokens, using zero pairs when the tray has too few tokens.
video_script.substitution: Lift the tokens being subtracted off the tray; put out zero pairs first if there are too few; read the answer from the tokens that stay.
video_script.anchor: a tray of positive and negative tokens
video_script.payoff_line: The six answers are positive three, negative four, negative five, negative three, positive two and positive four.

final_answer.spoken: positive three, negative four, negative five, negative three, positive two and positive four

maths_rules: (+9) − (+12): 3 zero pairs, take out 12 positive tokens, 3 negative tokens stay, so −3
(−5) − (−7): 2 zero pairs, take out 7 negative tokens, 2 positive tokens stay, so +2
(−2) − (−6): 4 zero pairs, take out 6 negative tokens, 4 positive tokens stay, so +4

check: 3 + 7 = 10; 4 + 4 = 8; 5 + 4 = 9; 3 negative and 12 positive less 3 zero pairs = 9 positive; 2 positive and 7 negative less 2 zero pairs = 5 negative; 4 positive and 6 negative less 4 zero pairs = 2 negative
video_script.design: Six subtractions on one board. Tokens are lifted off the tray, and zero pairs are put out first when the tray has too few. The check puts the taken tokens back.

beats.on_screen: small title card From your book; six subtractions are listed: (+10) − (+7), (−8) − (−4), (−9) − (−4), (+9) − (+12), (−5) − (−7), (−2) − (−6); the words What does each subtraction give? appear

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book, about subtracting with tokens.
<bookmark mark='six'/>There are six subtractions on the board, and we must do each one with tokens.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>What does each subtraction give?

beats.on_screen: the six subtractions and the question stay on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: a tray with green tokens; some tokens lift away; one green token and one red token joined by a ring labelled zero pair

marks.away: tokens lift off the tray when the minus sign is read as take away
marks.pair: one green token and one red token slide together and cancel inside a ring
marks.put: a zero pair is set on the tray and the value of the tray stays the same

beats.colours: positive tokens = green, negative tokens = red
narration: <bookmark mark='away'/>The minus sign tells us to take tokens away from the tray.
<bookmark mark='pair'/>One positive token and one negative token together are worth zero. Such a pair is called a zero pair.
<bookmark mark='put'/>When the tray has too few tokens, we put out zero pairs first. They do not change the value.

marks.one: the first three subtractions are written and lit
marks.two: the last three subtractions are written and lit

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Given, positive ten take away positive seven. Negative eight take away negative four. Negative nine take away negative four.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Then positive nine take away positive twelve. Negative five take away negative seven. Negative two take away negative six.

beats.on_screen: To find: the value of each subtraction

marks.find: the words the value of each subtraction are written and underlined

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the value of each subtraction.

beats.on_screen: Step 1: enough tokens, so lift them off. 10 − 7 = 3 green stay; 8 − 4 = 4 red stay; 9 − 4 = 5 red stay

marks.a: 7 of the 10 green tokens lift off and 3 green tokens stay
marks.b: 4 of the 8 red tokens lift off and 4 red tokens stay
marks.c: 4 of the 9 red tokens lift off and 5 red tokens stay

beats.colours: positive tokens = green, negative tokens = red
narration: <bookmark mark='a'/>Step one, the first three subtractions have enough tokens. Take seven positive tokens off ten, and three positive tokens stay.
<bookmark mark='b'/>Take four negative tokens off eight, and four negative tokens stay.
<bookmark mark='c'/>Take four negative tokens off nine, and five negative tokens stay.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: too few tokens, so put out zero pairs first. 3 pairs, 12 green out, 3 red stay; 2 pairs, 7 red out, 2 green stay; 4 pairs, 6 red out, 4 green stay

marks.d: 3 zero pairs are put on the tray of 9 green tokens, 12 green tokens lift off and 3 red tokens stay
marks.e: 2 zero pairs are put on the tray of 5 red tokens, 7 red tokens lift off and 2 green tokens stay
marks.f: 4 zero pairs are put on the tray of 2 red tokens, 6 red tokens lift off and 4 green tokens stay

beats.colours: positive tokens = green, negative tokens = red
narration: <bookmark mark='d'/>Step two, the next three have too few tokens. The fourth needs twelve positive tokens from nine, so we put out three zero pairs. Three negative tokens stay.
<bookmark mark='e'/>The fifth needs seven negative tokens from five, so we put out two zero pairs. Two positive tokens stay.
<bookmark mark='f'/>The last needs six negative tokens from two, so we put out four zero pairs. Four positive tokens stay.

beats.on_screen: Step 3, check: tokens that stay + tokens taken away = the start. 3 + 7 = 10; 4 + 4 = 8; 5 + 4 = 9; 3 red and 12 green, less 3 zero pairs, make 9 green; 2 green and 7 red, less 2 zero pairs, make 5 red; 4 green and 6 red, less 4 zero pairs, make 2 red

marks.back: the taken tokens are put back next to the tokens that stay
marks.again: each tray shows its starting tokens again

beats.colours: positive tokens = green, negative tokens = red
narration: <bookmark mark='back'/>Step three, check by putting the taken tokens back. Three tokens that stayed and seven taken make ten again.
<bookmark mark='again'/>The other answers rebuild their starting tokens in the same way, once we remove the zero pairs.

marks.rest: the last three answers (+9) − (+12) = −3, (−5) − (−7) = +2 and (−2) − (−6) = +4 are written and boxed

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>The six answers are positive three, negative four, negative five, negative three, positive two and positive four.
<bookmark mark='rest'/>Each answer takes its sign from the tokens that stay.
